article_title: B.C. Reg. 91/2026 – Commissioner of Income Tax
body:
Regulation: B.C. Reg. 91/2026
Made under: Income Tax Act
Published in: No. 10 – B.C. Regs. 83 to 93, June 2, 2026
Deposit date: May 28, 2026

B.C. Reg. 91/2026, deposited May 28, 2026, under theINCOME TAX ACT[section 131]. Regulation of the Commissioner of Income Tax, dated April 27, 2026. The Commissioner of Income Tax orders that, effective April 1, 2026, the Training Tax Credits Regulation, B.C. Reg. 243/2007, is amended as set out in the attached Appendix. — F. CAMILLERI,Commissioner of Income Tax. 1	Schedule 2 to the Training Tax Credits Regulation, B.C. Reg. 243/2007, is amended by adding the following item as indicated: Column 1Eligible Training Program 2	Schedule 3 is amended by adding the following item as indicated: Column 1EligibleApprenticeshipProgram Column 2Level 1 ApprenticeshipRequirement Column 3Level 2 ApprenticeshipRequirement complete 1 680 workbased hoursand level 1 technical training complete 3 360 workbased hoursand level 2 technical training Index Page|Previous Regulation|Next Regulation|Cumulative Index Page Copyright © 2026: King's Printer, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada

minutes_briefs.title: BC Training Tax Credits expanded with new eligible programs and apprenticeship levels
minutes_briefs.summary: British Columbia has updated its Training Tax Credits Regulation to add new eligible training programs and apprenticeship requirements. This change, effective April 1, 2026, means businesses may now claim tax credits for a wider range of employee training and apprenticeship costs. The amendment adds specific programs to Schedule 2 and sets new work-based hour and technical training requirements for Level 1 and Level 2 apprenticeships in Schedule 3.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Review the updated Schedules 2 and 3 to see if your training programs or apprenticeships now qualify for the tax credit.

key_dates.label: Training Tax Credits Regulation amendment takes effect (BC)
